explanation: From main: originHealth probes the data origin with a no-cors, no-store HEAD instead of a GET, so the hub light and error banners no longer download the 200 KB query manifest body. The diagnosis states, memo window and probe path are unchanged; EDGE_PROTECTION.md notes that the method rule admits HEAD. From the cross-study listing: geneRow and pathwayRow now set each row's significance tier once with significanceTier(q, p), and significant is that tier's FDR call; direction is unchanged, so the index and fallback paths still build identical rows. The unused summarizeGroup aggregate is removed from crossDataset.ts.
